correctness.rationale: The normalizations in RESULT.md give the exact even 2-by-2 and odd 1-by-1 Gram entries. The limiting normalized gap is exp(−a²)/sqrt(pi) times 2(a²−1/2)(a²−3/2). The first nonzero small-width perturbation of the simple rank-one even eigenvalue is analytic; its exact values at the two simple roots are ±2/3 after common normalization, implying the common +epsilon²/3 displacement of squared roots. Uniform analytic implicit-function theory proves precisely two internal roots; direct strict pointwise Hermite inequalities control the entire complement including a→infinity; the lower even eigenvalue is O(epsilon³) at both crossings. The standalone numerical and symbolic program returned PASS for 565 checks, but finite testing is not the logical proof.

value.rationale: A pair of symmetric disjoint detectors is a natural time-frequency observation aperture. Three Hermite modes are the least-dimensional oscillator band where a two-dimensional even subspace competes with a nonzero odd subspace. The result determines the optimizer parity over the full unbounded separation range for every sufficiently small fixed half-width, including exact number of phase transitions, their two-dimensional degeneracies and universal matching finite-width threshold drift; this is a complete structural classification rather than an arbitrary parameter evaluation.
